exposure: hysteroscopic repair of cesarean scar defect
patients with cesarean scar defect undergoing hysteroscopic repair
patients undergoing hysteroscopic treatment for other uterine lesions
cohort: Patients with cesarean scar defect undergoing frozen embryo transfer.
finding: Hysteroscopic treatment of cesarean scar defect in symptomatic patients undergoing frozen embryo transfer did not increase the risk of pregnancy complications and led to comparable clinical pregnancy rates with asymptomatic patients.
